_: The shop itself — the facts that must never differ between the website, the app, an email and an invoice. Edit here, run `npm run sync` at the repo root. See shared/README.md.
name: Freshness To Your Home
_categoryLook: How each category looks as a tile in the catalogue, on the website and in the app alike: a soft ground, the ink for its count, and the product whose photograph stands for it. A category added later in the admin panel falls back to paper and its first product's photo.
_map: Where the map opens when no pin has been dropped yet — the middle of Baku. The embedded picker replaces this once there is a Maps key; see VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY.
